summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py. TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default off), a static render_speed method, and speed rendering when the total is unknown. track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column. Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables with no total. The two ValueError assertions were removed from the tests, and test_task_progress_column_speed was added. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black), and nothing was committed.
